usedFor: NileDesk runs low-code business processes, with “Create Process Item” submitting one and “Create Draft Board Item” saving a draft.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Process Item” in NileDesk
bestTemplate.why: It creates and submits a new process item, so a request enters the process straight away.

watchOut: “Create Process Item” submits straight away, while the draft actions only save, so pick the one you mean.
